nodes.description: Private owner address of the Ownable contract; controls onlyOwner gated functionality.
mapping(address=>bool) blacklist/whitelist flag; when true for a sender, _transfer reverts.
mapping of account balances mutated by _transfer, burning and _burni.
Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount written by _approve.
Total token supply; increased by burning() and decreased by _burni().
Token decimals, set to 9 in constructor.
Token symbol string set in constructor.
Token name string set in constructor.
Initializes name/symbol/decimals and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
Public function gated by a hardcoded address equality check that writes arbitrary blacklist flags into useinmanage.
Public function with hardcoded-address access check that calls burning(), minting new tokens without any real burn semantics.
Internal function that ADDS to _totalSupply and _balances (a hidden mint), despite its 'burning' name.
Core transfer logic; enforces zero-address checks and a useinmanage blacklist gate before moving balances.
Internal burn that subtracts from balance and total supply using SafeMath.sub.
Internal approval writer for the _allowances mapping with zero-address checks.
External transferFrom performing a transfer then subtracting from allowance.
External transfer delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
External approval delegating to _approve with _msgSender().
Increases spender allowance using SafeMath.add.
Decreases spender allowance using SafeMath.sub.
onlyOwner function setting _owner to address(0).
Public view returning _owner.
Internal wrapper burning _msgSender() balance via _burni.
Internal burn from account then deducts allowance via _approve.
Context helper returning msg.sender as address payable.
Checked addition used in burning, _transfer and increaseAllowance.
Checked subtraction used in _transfer, _burni, transferFrom and decreaseAllowance.
External caller address, the untrusted input driving access checks and balance mutations.
Hidden mint: burning()/UserBalance() increase _totalSupply and _balances at will for the privileged hardcoded caller.
Authorization based on equality with hardcoded address 0x15Fc0B3d9fecd4709C0CF2d1E427EC65805ac9f3 rather than the owner role.
Privileged mutation of the useinmanage blacklist that can block any address from transferring.
recipient parameter of transfer(address,uint256).
amount parameter used by UserBalance, burning and transfer paths.
sender parameter of _transfer(address,address,uint256).
account parameter of burning/_burni/_burnFrom.
spender parameter of approve/_approve.
owner parameter of _approve(address,address,uint256).

edges.reason: constructor uses msg.sender as the recipient of the entire initial supply
_msgSender() returns msg.sender directly
_msgSender() result flows into _transfer as the sender argument in transfer paths
msg.sender address is used to read _balances and the useinmanage blacklist inside _transfer
msg.sender is used as owner of allowance writes through _approve
msg.sender is compared against a hardcoded privileged address before burning/minting
msg.sender is compared against a hardcoded privileged address before writing the blacklist
_burnFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender when reducing allowance
transfer delegates execution to _transfer
transferFrom delegates execution to _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance
approve delegates execution to _approve
increaseAllowance calls _approve with the summed allowance
decreaseAllowance calls _approve with the subtracted allowance
_burn delegates to _burni for the caller
_burnFrom calls _burni on the target account
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the caller allowance
UserBalance calls burning to credit tokens to the caller
UserBalance gates execution on the hardcoded privileged address comparison
transferOwnership gates execution on the hardcoded privileged address comparison
once past the hardcoded check, transferOwnership writes arbitrary blacklist flags
burning increases _totalSupply and the account balance, i.e. an arbitrary mint
UserBalance can mint unbacked tokens to the privileged caller via burning
burning adds amount to _totalSupply
burning adds amount to _balances[account]
_burni subtracts amount from _balances[account]
_burni subtracts amount from _totalSupply
_transfer subtracts from sender balance and adds to recipient balance
_transfer reads useinmanage[sender] and reverts blacklisted senders
transferOwnership writes useinmanage[account] = value
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances
constructor assigns _balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply
constructor sets _totalSupply = 1000000000000000 * 10**9, an unchecked literal multiplication
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0) after the onlyOwner check
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance deduction
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the allowance
_burni uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply reduction
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance
_burnFrom uses SafeMath.sub to reduce the allowance
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance credit
burning uses SafeMath.add on total supply and balance
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add on the allowance
recipient parameter drives the destination of transfer
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer
amount parameter is the mint quantity passed to burning
amount parameter is added to total supply and balance inside burning
sender parameter determines whose balance and blacklist flag are read
account parameter receives the minted balance in burning
account parameter is debited in _burni
account parameter is the burned-from account in _burnFrom
spender parameter is delegated to _approve
owner parameter keys the _allowances mapping in _approve

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists as the destination argument of the transfer entry point.
Amount parameter is the value that ultimately drives the hidden mint through burning().
Sender parameter is exclusively consumed by the internal _transfer balance and blacklist logic.
Account parameter is the beneficiary of the supply-increasing burning() call.
Spender parameter only flows into the approval entry point.
Owner parameter only keys the allowance mapping inside _approve.
addedValue parameter is used solely in the increaseAllowance arithmetic.
subtractedValue parameter is used solely in the decreaseAllowance arithmetic.
newOwner parameter is only consumed by the internal ownership writer.
value parameter is only written into the useinmanage blacklist by transferOwnership.
Local msgSender is a transient copy of _msgSender() used only for constructor ownership initialization.
